主要内容: The article discusses the potential economic impact of self-driving vehicles, estimating that the global passenger economy could be worth $7 trillion by 2050. Strategy Analytics and Intel predict that the market will grow significantly, with $3.7 trillion from consumer mobility-as-a-service, $2.9 trillion from business-to-business mobility-as-a-service, and $203 billion from pilotless vehicle services. While it is too early to determine which companies will benefit the most, the study highlights the transformative potential of autonomous vehicles, including increased productivity and safety improvements. The benefits are expected to be most pronounced in urban and suburban areas, but analysts believe rural areas will also see adoption. The study also estimates that pilotless vehicles could save at least 585,000 lives between 2035 and 2050.
